review_scope: Changed upstream API, native function classification, shared frontend regressions, both host-only hardware drivers, operational provenance, public APIs, native safety and viewer regression. Not a formal soundness proof or full ISA review.

resolved_findings.finding: Native AMD shared_allocations bypassed the source-only guard.
resolved_findings.resolution: The temporary API was removed upstream at b3a3791. Its exports, extra tests and guard relocation were retired; the original PTX source-analysis guard is unchanged.

resolved_findings.finding: Unrelated helper instructions blocked supported entry kernels; naive skipping risks labels, calls and fallthrough.
resolved_findings.resolution: Classify descriptor/metadata entries before instruction parsing; require explicit bounded helper declarations, retain module validation, reject unsupported entry code and inter-function control flow. Sixteen adversarial regressions pass.

resolved_findings.finding: size_t multiplication could wrap negative alternating input values to huge positive values.
resolved_findings.resolution: Use explicit double sign/magnitude, test negative odd coordinates and all generated finite bounded inputs; discard earlier trial evidence and rerun.

resolved_findings.finding: Failed preflight could leave an earlier PASS receipt.
resolved_findings.resolution: Atomic fresh incomplete receipt before operational validation; current-invocation failures never preserve a success.

resolved_findings.finding: Requested ROCm library hash could differ from loaded HIP runtime.
resolved_findings.resolution: Record ldd under the execution environment; hash resolved library; core requires exact requested-runtime match.

resolved_findings.finding: Inherited HSA architecture overrides could spoof runtime-reported target.
resolved_findings.resolution: Reject HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION variables by presence, including empty and per-node variants; validate actual gfx1250 wave32 identity.

resolved_findings.finding: Comparing only present upstream descriptor keys could miss dropped fields.
resolved_findings.resolution: Compare complete inline descriptor maps and require byte-identical upstream fixture copies.

resolved_findings.finding: Checking only the target prefix accepted unknown, repeated and conflicting feature suffixes.
resolved_findings.resolution: Validate complete XNACK/SRAM-ECC suffix grammar, preserve valid selections, reject duplicate/conflicting/unknown features in both AMD paths; fix the upstream positive v7 allocation control to declare eight VGPRs. Descriptor launch eligibility remains explicitly outside this instruction-only lowering API.

rust.followup: Latest upstream integration removed the temporary direct-IR API and adds independent AMD lowering; final workspace results are recorded after that integration.

validation.rustdoc: strict broken-link and bare-URL checks pass
validation.format: new/owned Rust and Python files checked; workspace-wide rustfmt still reports pre-existing formatting differences

remaining_scope_limits: Selected ISA subset, not full gfx1250 coverage.
One unclustered workgroup in the analysis model; supplemental multi-block copy hardware tests do not expand that scope.
Bounded decoded-F32 workload family counterparts, not original PTX shape/dtype/grid parity.
Mathematical real-number abstraction does not establish IEEE exceptional behavior or physical error bounds.
